n_52994d5e3fba25f6.name: Choose the next email
n_52994d5e3fba25f6.source: export default function nextMessage({events,previousState}){if(!Array.isArray(events)||events.length>50)throw Error('Invalid Gmail poll');if(events.some(x=>!x||typeof x.messageId!=='string'||!x.messageId)||new Set(events.map(x=>x.messageId)).size!==events.length)throw Error('Invalid or repeated message ID');let index=previousState===null?0:previousState.index+1;if(!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>events.length)throw Error('Invalid progress');return{state:{index},more:index<events.length,messageId:index<events.length?events[index].messageId:''};}

n_4b0d9c515ba76ff5.name: Verify complete attachment
n_4b0d9c515ba76ff5.source:
import{Buffer}from'node:buffer';
export default async function attachmentContent({remote,inline,transitUrl,size,expectedMessageId,expectedAttachmentId,downloadedMessageId,downloadedAttachmentId,downloadedSize},context){let bytes;if(remote){if(downloadedMessageId!==expectedMessageId||downloadedAttachmentId!==expectedAttachmentId||downloadedSize!==size)throw Error('Unexpected Gmail attachment result');if(typeof transitUrl!=='string'||!/^https:\/\//.test(transitUrl))throw Error('Invalid attachment transit URL');const response=await context.fetch(transitUrl,{method:'GET'});if(!response.ok)throw Error('Attachment download failed');bytes=Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());}else{if(typeof inline!=='string'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]*={0,2}$/.test(inline))throw Error('Invalid inline attachment');bytes=Buffer.from(inline,'base64url');if(bytes.toString('base64url')!==inline.replace(/=+$/,''))throw Error('Invalid inline attachment encoding');}if(bytes.length!==size)throw Error('Attachment size mismatch');return{contentBase64:bytes.length?bytes.toString('base64'):null};}

n_959fe2ee8ca5b8ea.name: Confirm the Drive file
n_959fe2ee8ca5b8ea.source: export default function attachmentReceipt({id}){if(typeof id!=='string'||!id)throw Error('Drive did not confirm file creation; inspect Drive before retrying');return {ok:true};}
